zd: the logger's help text: "URL params: ?logLevel=debug&logCategories=Cache,Renderer"; it reads both from `window.location.search`. Census: defined by this class only; one access in logger.js (the constructor), two in the shared scenarios
Ld: its result is shown under the key `level` of `window.__log`; it returns the key of the table of level names whose number is `this.level`, or "unknown"; "name" is inferred. Census: defined by this class only; two accesses, both in logger.js
Dd: returns `this.level`. Census: defined by this class only; no access in the client, two in the shared scenarios
Id: sets `this.errorSink`. Census: defined by this class only; no access in the client, three in the shared scenarios
Wd: returns `this.breadcrumbs`. Census: defined by this class only; no access in the client, six in the shared scenarios
Hd: pushes `{ level, category, message, at }` onto `this.breadcrumbs` and keeps the last 30; "add" is inferred. Census: defined by this class only; three accesses, all `this.Hd` in logger.js
Rd: sets `this.breadcrumbs.length = 0`. Census: defined by this class only; no access in the client, four in the shared scenarios
Td: inferred: the test every log method and `isEnabled` make before they print: the level against `this.level`, the category against `disabledCategories` and `enabledCategories`. Census: defined by this class only; six accesses, all `this.Td` in logger.js

Xh: true when the item type has a `wearPos1`, a `maleModel0` or a `femaleModel0`; SimulationEngine.getEquipmentSlotForItem asks it before it maps `wearPos1` to an equipment slot, and isAmmoSlotItem before it tests `wearPos1` for 13; "wearable" is inferred from `wearPos1`. Census: defined by this class only; two accesses, both in engine/SimulationEngine.js on what `objTypeLoader.load(itemId)` returns
